verdict.rationale: The evidence says the Innovator Founder route must be applied for online and describes separate in-country and out-of-country flows. None of the cited pages say whether an applicant can start without creating an account, or describe a keyless or file-number entry path. The axis applies to a government online filing service, but no evidence shows it is delivered.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
